description: Decorative fountains managed by the City of Brussels is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Fontaines ornementales gérées par la Ville de Bruxelles De nombreux monuments, des fontaines, des statues et des œuvres d'art contemporain agrémentent et enrichissent l'espace public de la Ville de Bruxelles. Ces installations, révélatrices de l'évolution de la société, marquent l'intérêt de la Ville pour l'art urbain et, souvent, questionnent les promeneurs. Plus d’info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Public space. Its keywords are Water, Fountain, freshness, Heritage, art, public space. The portal shows 49 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
